thesis: Low leverage and earnings growth establish a serious value candidate, but commodity normalization is unresolved. Near-high momentum cannot be treated as a dip opportunity.
strongest_counterexample: The 12.10x multiple, volume gains and positive FCF offer fundamental support even using modest H1 profit growth.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of declining profit excluding derivative gains.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive profit growth excluding derivative gains and positive FCF.
evidence_gaps: Realized palm prices, derivative contribution and normalized cash earnings.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Recent profit improvement, cash flow and modest leverage are supportive
Volume gains and low leverage support a serious value candidate, but the much smaller half-year increase and derivative effects still require cycle normalization
